# E0307: method signature differs from the trait's

Callers rely on the signature that the trait declares, so the impl's method takes the same parameters and returns the same result, with `Self` as the impl's type.

- Rule: [`traits.impl-signatures`](../../reference/11-traits.md#traits.impl-signatures)
- Reported at: the method's name.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0307:8
trait Shape {
  fn area(self) -> f64
}

type Square = { side: i64 }

impl Shape for Square {
  fn area(self) -> i64 { self.side * self.side }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
trait Shape {
  fn area(self) -> f64
}

type Square = { side: f64 }

impl Shape for Square {
  fn area(self) -> f64 { self.side * self.side }
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0307_method_signature_differs_from_the_trait_s.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0307_method_signature_differs_from_the_trait_s.lt):

```text
  8 │   fn area(self) -> i64 { self.side * self.side }
    │      ^^^^

Callers rely on the signature that the trait declares, so the impl's method
takes the same parameters and returns the same result, with `Self` as the impl's
type.
```
